purpose: Recover a reliable read-only UI route from the accepted Dimensionen list to Dimensionswerte for PRODUCTLINE, COSTCENTER and CHANNEL before any master-data or global-dimension write gate.
acceptanceCriteria: playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE context is proven before any Dimension page interaction.
Dimensions list is accepted only with visible Dimensionen title and dimension codes.
Dimension Values are accepted only when the page/dialog visibly belongs to the selected dimension code.
Search overlay, Role Center and Intercompany Dimension Value Assignment are rejected as Dimension Values proof.
No Dimension, Dimension Value, setup, default dimension, master data, draft, Preview Posting, Posting or API shortcut is executed.
Screenshots explain what a key user sees and what the route still does not prove.
